name: CustomerExposure
description: Static obligo per customer, as in Priority
technicalDescription: Mirror, read-only (customer_exposure). One row per customer: the obligo (אובליגו) total exactly as Priority computes it, with asOf. Never computed by the app. The dynamic obligo is computed at display time by GetCreditExposure and never stored. Replaces Customers.obligoUsed / obligoPct.
